description: Change how new conversations are automatically given to team members. Pass ONLY the settings to change; everything else stays as it is. Call get_assignment_rules first to see the current values, the teams and the operators you can use. Examples: turn it on with mode="round_robin"; cap each operator at 10 chats with max_open=10; move a chat nobody answered within 15 minutes with reassign_after_minutes=15; set max_open/reassign_after_minutes/team_id/fallback_user_id to null to clear them. A backup operator (fallback_user_id) is required when after_last_hop or when_full is "fallback". Returns the settings before and after. Sends nothing to customers and does not move existing chats by itself (use reassign_conversations for that).

after_last_hop.description: After the last move: stay = keep the last operator; fallback = give it to the backup operator.

awaiting_window_days.description: Days an unanswered chat keeps counting against its operator (1-90). Used with count_basis=awaiting.

count_basis.description: What the cap counts: open = assigned open chats; awaiting = chats where the customer is waiting for a reply.

fallback_user_id.description: Backup operator id (from get_assignment_rules choices.operators); null = none.

max_open.description: Max conversations one operator may hold (1-500); null = no cap.

mode.description: off = no automatic assignment by this rule; round_robin = operators take turns; least_open = operator with the fewest chats.

on_reopen.description: true = a conversation the customer reopens is assigned again by this rule.

only_available.description: true = skip operators who are away/offline.

reassign_after_minutes.description: Move a chat to another operator when its operator has not replied after this many minutes (1-1440); null = never.

reassign_keep_previous.description: true = after such a move, the operator who did not reply stays on the chat too.

reassign_max_hops.description: How many times one waiting chat may be moved (1-10).

rebalance.description: true = move chats off an operator who holds more than max_open.

release_on_offline.description: true = when an operator sets herself Offline, her chats still waiting for a reply move at once to an available teammate (same team and cap); chats she already answered stay.

team_id.description: Only members of this active team receive conversations; null = all operators with live-chat access.

when_full.description: When everyone is at the cap: wait = the chat waits until someone has room; fallback = give it to the backup operator.

name: update_assignment_rules
